correctness.rationale: Every maximal-rank square-zero X admits X=[[0,I],[0,0]]. The twist forces Y=[[A,C],[0,zeta A]], and Y^2=0 iff A^2=0 and AC+zeta CA=0. For square-zero A of rank j, block multiplication gives an unrestricted h=r-2j square block C_HH, exactly q^(2j(r-j)) lifts per C_HH, and rankY=2j+rankC_HH. Counting the rank-j A and rank-t C_HH yields the Gaussian sum in all characteristics. The total X factor is also exact. Attached standard-library code directly checks seven full block enumerations over F2,F3,F4, twists 1,2,3.

originality.rationale: Huang (2022), Theorem 1.2(c) and Remark 4.1, already proves the aggregate nilpotent-pair twist independence; this is explicitly acknowledged. Neither that invariant nor Huang's linear twisted-centralizer parametrization gives the number with both squares zero, fixed maximal first rank, and every prescribed second rank. The proven quotient-block rank relation and Gaussian sum provide a distinct, meaningful refinement. Bergh/Erdmann (2007) studies homology, Chen/Wang (2018) and Chen/Lu (2019) geometric components, not these coefficients. Comparisons against published research statements and targeted mathematical-record searches disclosed no equivalent formula. Residual uncertainty about implicit consequences remains.

value.rationale: The fixed-first-generator stratum is the intrinsic maximal-rank (open dense) square-zero locus, naturally the free-module locus over k[u]/u^2 in representations of the four-dimensional quantum complete intersection. The complete rank-of-Y enumerator gives a structural arithmetic classification in every even dimension, rather than an arbitrary numerical slice. Huang's known aggregate independence under zeta does not imply invariance of each nonlinear square-zero rank fiber; the new theorem establishes it uniformly with exact Gaussian multiplicities.
